name: kai-explainer-thumbnail-cycle-round
description: One explicit thumbnail-cycle pass; called by kai-explainer.

data.agentDefinition: Archon node `thumbnail-generate` in kai-explainer-thumbnail-cycle-round. Completes only its assigned work.
data.prompt:
Project: $INPUTS.project. You are executing the active assigned Archon node. This invocation authorizes the work; do not search for a workflow run, start another controller, or stop after reading instructions. Complete the required files/library calls before finishing. Read AGENTS.md, docs/production.md and jobs/scripts/$INPUTS.project/production-profile.json and personalities/kai-explainer/PROFILE.md. Work only in this project's folders. Follow the applicable repository skill. Preserve supplied recordings, approved narration, evidence and provenance. Never answer human attention on their behalf. Archon owns stage progression. Complete only this node's assignment. Use direct library functions and the documented Archon adapters. Use actual image viewing capability for inspection; disclose unavailable inspection instead of claiming a pass.
Read docs/publishing.md. Make or repair variants at the saved canvas dimensions. Use lib/thumbnails.mjs exportThumbnail for full PNG and feed preview. Read thumbnailStatus for requested count and per-variant feedback; preserve unchanged passing variants. Write BRIEF.md with Title, Headline, Description and original editable SVG with actual heavy fonts. Use the pinned local node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-800-normal.woff2 for heavy type; embed the actual font in the editable SVG. Do not search the web for a font. Inspect and export actual files, not a plan. Do not review your own variants.
